text: As part of the new road design for Malcolm Road, Transportation Services has recommended that a left-turn prohibition from Millwood Road onto Malcolm Road will address safety concerns related to turning vehicles. Therefore, I'm requesting a left-turn prohibition at the intersection to facilitate safe traffic operation.
City Council on March 26 and 27, 2018, adopted the following: 1. City Council prohibit eastbound left turns at all times at the intersection of Millwood Road and Malcolm Road.
